steps.name: ntsc
steps.script:
# Build an ntsc-rs settings preset from the layer params: enum values arrive as
# strings ("2") and ntsc-rs wants numbers; seed and scale are pipeline flags.
jq -c 'del(.seed, .scale)
  | with_entries(if (.value | type) == "string" then .value |= tonumber else . end)
  | . + {version: 1}' "$VB_PARAMS" > "$VB_WORK/settings.json"
args=(--seed "$VB_P_SEED" --preset "$VB_WORK/settings.json" -o "$VB_OUT")
if [ "$VB_P_SCALE" -gt 0 ]; then args+=(--scale "$VB_P_SCALE"); fi
analog-pass "${args[@]}" "$VB_IN"

summary: NTSC/VHS analog simulation via ntsc-rs (pipelines/analog-pass) with every ntsc-rs setting exposed. Defaults reproduce presets/vhs.json exactly (ntsc-rs legacy values fill keys that preset omits).
